text: A contemplative poem of David, when he was in the cave, a prayer.
I cry aloud with my voice to ADONAI. With my voice I seek favor from ADONAI.
I pour out my complaint before Him, before Him I tell my trouble.
When my spirit grows faint within me, You know my path. In the way where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
Look at my right hand and see, for no one cares about me. I have no refuge — no one cares for my soul.
I have cried out to You, ADONAI. I said: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry, for I am brought very low. Rescue me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Bring my soul out of prison, so I may praise Your Name. The righteous will triumph through me, for You will reward me.
